analyzed_vuln.description: Heap out-of-bounds read due to missing bounds validation when parsing IPv6 extension headers. In IPv6Layer::parseExtensions(), a new IPv6Extension object is created at the current offset and newExt->getExtensionLen() / newExt->getBaseHeader()->nextHeader are read immediately, but there is no check that the full extension base header (and declared extension length) is within m_DataLen at that offset. As a result, getBaseHeader()->headerLen in IPv6Extension::getExtensionLen() reads past the packet buffer.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: FuzzTarget feeds a malformed/truncated packet through PcapFileReaderDevice into Packet::setRawPacket(), which reaches NflogLayer::parseNextLayer() and constructs IPv6Layer for NFLOG payload marked as IPv6. If IPv6Layer::isDataValid passes but payload is too short/inconsistent for the extension chain, parseExtensions() enters its loop (offset starts at sizeof(ip6_hdr) and only checks a generic loop condition) and attempts to parse an extension at/near buffer end. Accessing extension headerLen/nextHeader then causes OOB read (crash in IPv6Extension::getExtensionLen at IPv6Extensions.h:51).
